Name: SpouseDiary
Author: Changbaibai
Description:
[size=4][b]配偶日记 (Spouse Diary)[/b][/size]

[b]简介[/b]
结婚之后，你的配偶每天都会写一篇私人日记。你也可以写日记，配偶第二天会对你的日记进行批注和对话讨论。
日记由AI根据你前一天的实际游戏行为生成，完全基于角色性格，每篇都是独一无二的。

[b]功能[/b]
[list]
[*]AI生成配偶视角日记：配偶会根据你的每日行为（去了哪里、送了什么礼物、赚了多少钱、打了什么怪、几点睡的觉……）写出符合角色性格的日记[/*]
[*]写日记功能：默认按J打开菜单，你可以每天写一篇日记，配偶在第二天将对你的日记进行批注，并且有对话反应。[/*]
[*]全角色性格适配：自动匹配星露谷所有可婚NPC的性格特征和语气[/*]
[*]丰富的行为追踪：记录送礼、出货、购物、种植、浇水、钓鱼、战斗、采集、烹饪、NPC互动等数据[/*]
[*]特殊事件反应：配偶生日、节日活动、玩家被击倒、凌晨晕倒等场景都会在日记中体现[/*]
[*]情感互动：送礼给其他异性NPC时配偶可能会吃醋，整天不回家时配偶会担心[/*]
[*]历史日记浏览：按快捷键(默认J)随时翻看所有历史日记[/*]
[*]按存档隔离：每个存档的日记数据独立保存[/*]
[*]自定义API：支持任何兼容OpenAI格式的AI接口（OpenAI、Claude、国内各大模型API等）[/*]
[/list]
[b]使用方法[/b]
1. 安装mod后，编辑 config.json，填入你的API地址和密钥、模型
2. 正常游戏，结婚后第二天起每天早上会收到配偶的日记（以信件形式弹出）
3. 按J键可以浏览所有历史日记

[b]配置说明[/b]
[list]
[*][b]ModEnabled[/b] - MOD总开关（默认开启）[/*]
[*][b]DiaryFrequency[/b] - 日记生成频率，每X天生成一次（默认每天）[/*]
[*][b]OpenDiaryKey[/b] - 打开历史日记快捷键（默认J）[/*]
[*][b]ApiUrl[/b] - AI接口地址（兼容OpenAI格式）[/*]
[*][b]ApiKey[/b] - 你的API密钥[/*]
[*][b]ModelName[/b] - 使用的模型名称[/*]
[*][b]SystemPrompt[/b] - 系统提示词（支持自定义）[/*]
[*][b]MaxTokens[/b] - 最大返回Token数[/*]
[*][b]TimeoutSeconds[/b] - API请求超时时间[/*]
[/list]
[b]注意事项[/b]
[list]
[*]需要自备AI API密钥[/*]
[*]生成日记需要网络连接[/*]
[*]仅对NPC配偶生效，多人模式下与真人玩家结婚时自动禁用[/*]
[*]API调用会产生费用，请注意用量[/*]
[/list]
[b]兼容性[/b]
[list]
[*]需要 SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6+[/*]
[*]与大多数mod兼容[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Spouse Diary[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]Overview[/b][/size]
After marriage, your spouse writes a private diary entry every day.
Each diary is uniquely generated by AI based on your actual gameplay from the previous day, written entirely in-character with your spouse's personality.

[size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]AI-generated spouse diary: Your spouse observes and reacts to your daily actions (where you went, gifts given, money earned, monsters fought, what time you went to bed...) and writes a diary in their unique voice[/*]
[*]Diary Writing Feature: By default, press J to open the menu. You can write one diary entry per day. Your spouse will annotate your diary the next day and have conversational reactions to it.[/*]
[*]Character-accurate personalities: Automatically matches the personality and tone of all marriageable NPCs in Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]Comprehensive behavior tracking: Tracks gift-giving, shipping, shopping, planting, watering, fishing, combat, foraging, cooking, NPC interactions, and more[/*]
[*]Special event reactions: Spouse birthdays, festival days, player getting knocked out, passing out at 2AM — all reflected naturally in the diary[/*]
[*]Emotional depth: Your spouse may get jealous if you gift other NPCs, worry if you stay out all day, or feel hurt if you forget their birthday[/*]
[*]Diary history browser: Press a hotkey (default: J) to browse all past diary entries anytime[/*]
[*]Per-save isolation: Diary data is saved separately for each save file[/*]
[*]Custom API support: Works with any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint [/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
1. Install the mod, then edit config.json to enter your API URL and key
2. Play normally — starting the day after marriage, you'll receive a diary letter from your spouse each morning
3. Press J to browse all past diary entries

[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]ModEnabled[/b] - Master toggle (default: true)[/*]
[*][b]DiaryFrequency[/b] - Generate a diary every X days (default: 1)[/*]
[*][b]OpenDiaryKey[/b] - Hotkey to open diary browser (default: J)[/*]
[*][b]ApiUrl[/b] - AI API endpoint (OpenAI-compatible format)[/*]
[*][b]ApiKey[/b] - Your API key[/*]
[*][b]ModelName[/b] - Model to use[/*]
[*][b]SystemPrompt[/b] - System prompt template (customizable)[/*]
[*][b]MaxTokens[/b] - Maximum response tokens[/*]
[*][b]TimeoutSeconds[/b] - API request timeout[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Important Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires your own AI API key [/*]
[*]Requires internet connection for diary generation[/*]
[*]Only works with NPC spouses — automatically disabled when married to another player in multiplayer[/*]
[*]API calls may incur costs — please monitor your usage[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Compatible with most mods[/*]
[/list]
